title: Book a space
subtitle: Book a hot desk or meeting room now, or request a monthly space.
modeLegend: What do you want to do?

instant.title: Book now
instant.text: Hot desk day pass or meeting room. Choose a time, then pay online or use a package.

request.title: Request a monthly space
request.text: Dedicated desk or private office. Send a request and the team will contact you.

unavailable.text: New bookings are not available for your account right now. Contact the branch and we will help.

noSpaces.title: No spaces to book yet
noSpaces.text: Spaces appear here when the branch publishes them. Contact us if you need a space now.

when.heading: Choose date and time
when.dateHelp: Today or any day in the next 12 months.
when.dateInvalid: Choose today or a later date within the next year.
when.slotsHelp: Struck-through times are taken or do not fit the length you chose. Times are on the Alexandria clock.
when.noSlots: No times are left on this day. Choose another date.
when.noFit: {time} is not free for {length}. Choose another start time.
when.noSeats: No seats are left on this day. Choose another date.
when.timeRequired: Choose a start time to continue.
when.dateRequired: Choose a valid date to continue.
when.seatsRequired: No seats are left on this day. Choose another date to continue.

review.heading: Review and pay
review.payLegend: How do you want to pay?
review.usePackage: Use my package ({left} left, covers this booking fully)
review.packageShort: Your {name} package has {left} left. That does not cover this booking fully, so you pay the full price.
review.packagesFailed: We could not check your packages. You can still pay online.
review.hold: We hold your slot for 15 minutes while you pay. Nothing is charged until you finish paying.
review.holdPackage: Your package balance is used as soon as you confirm.
review.verifyNote: Verify your email before paying. Use Send the link again in the banner at the top of the page. You can still hold your slot now.
review.busyPay: Holding your slot and opening secure payment

errors.slotTakenTimes: Choose one of the nearest free times.
errors.slotTakenDays: That day is full. Choose one of the nearest days with seats.
errors.slotTakenNone: No nearby option is free. Go back and choose another time or date.
errors.emailNotVerified: Verify your email before paying. Use Send the link again in the banner at the top of the page, then try again. Your slot stays held for 15 minutes.
errors.gateway: The payment page is not available right now. Nothing was charged and your slot is held.
errors.holdExpired: The 15-minute hold ran out and the slot was released.
errors.notAllowed: New bookings are not available for your account right now. Contact the branch and we will help.
errors.alreadyBooked: You already have a booking for this space on that day.
errors.invalidTime: That time cannot be booked. Go back and choose another time.

details.heading: Start date and term
details.startDateHelp: From today onward. The team confirms the final date with you.
details.startDateInvalid: Choose today or a later date within the next year.
details.termInvalid: Choose a term of 3, 6 or 12 months.
details.totalNote: Based on the monthly price. The team confirms the final amount and deposit in your invoice.
details.notesHelp: Team size, equipment, or anything else we should know.
details.notesTooLong: Notes can be up to 1000 characters.

documents.heading: Documents and consent
documents.introIndividual: Upload your national ID or passport so the team can review your request faster.
documents.introCompany: Upload your commercial registration. If you can, add an identity document for the person who will sign.
documents.optional: You can send the request without documents. The team will ask for anything missing.
documents.hint: PDF, JPG or PNG, up to 5 MB each.
documents.private: Documents are private. Only the Flux team can open them, through short-lived secure links.
documents.loadFailed: We could not load your documents.
documents.fileType: {name}: upload a PDF, JPG or PNG file.
documents.fileSize: {name}: the file is larger than 5 MB. Choose a smaller file.
documents.limit: You can keep up to 10 documents. Remove one to add another.
documents.consentBefore: I agree that Flux Business Hub stores these documents and my details to review this request, as described in the
documents.consentRequired: Confirm that you agree before sending the request.

errors.tooMany: You have three requests waiting for review. We will contact you about them first.
errors.notAllowed: New requests are not available for your account right now. Contact the branch and we will help.

done.heading: Request sent
done.next2: We contact you about the deposit and your invoice.
done.next3: You follow the status in My bookings and pay the invoice with one of our usual methods, such as cash, bank transfer, Instapay or a mobile wallet.
done.pendingNote: If your account is new, its status changes to Pending Approval while we review the request. You can still book hot desks and meeting rooms.
